summary.text: A silverpoint drawing is made by dragging a silver rod or wire across a surface, often prepared with gesso or ground of Chinese white. Silverpoint is one of several types of metalpoint used by scribes, craftsmen and artists since ancient times.
these other drawing techniques required less effort and were more forgiving than silver, which resists erasure and leaves a fainter line.
